reviews.title: Calibrate AS3 Flash Player and AIR simulated/bounded APIs from working to partial (A-01)
reviews.summary: Demotes in-memory desktop, OS process, raw socket, DRM, P2P RTMFP, worker concurrency, sampler, Stage3D/Pixel Bender, FTE and hardware capture simulations from working to partial with explicit notes naming browser and runtime boundaries.
